run_multiprocessing_eval: run multi-GPU distributed evaluation of a diplomacy agent using the multiprocessing_eval CLI script
run_eval_with_model: run the multiprocessing_eval script with a specific model file and dataset for evaluation
register_all_agents: register all diplomacy agents including generator, classifier, and prefix generation agents
register_all_tasks: register all diplomacy tasks including dialogue, order, and classifier tasks
review_multiprocessing_eval_entry: review the multiprocessing_eval entry point that launches distributed evaluation with registered agents and tasks
